notes: What a person has decided about who is who in data/players.json (lib/players/registry-schema.ts PlayerIdentitySchema). Curated, never guessed: every entry says why. scripts/build-players.ts reads it on every build.

sameAs ties a name on one team's lists to a MaxPreps career or to another name; rowSplits takes a MaxPreps row out of the career it is filed under; distinct keeps two careers that share a name on one team apart; notSame records that two look-alike names are two people.

rowSplits.name: Ayva Garcia
rowSplits.basis: MaxPreps files two Leigh rows under career k2kl80co8kck4 (read 2026-11-13): the varsity roster's Adriana Yam (#43, grade 10, row created 2026-08-26, career link .../athletes/adriana-yam/) and the JV roster's Ayva Garcia (#44, grade 10, row created 2026-09-16, career link .../athletes/ayva-garcia/). The two names share nothing, so they are read as two players. The career stays with the varsity row, which was created first; that choice is a convention, not a finding.
